notes.title: Why No Greek? Now Over 130 Languages :)
improved Spelling studying
notes.content: Improved spelling subjects. To create a spelling word, make the question and answer the same.

notes.title: Fixed Errors - Let me know if you find any bugs
notes.content:
Fixed Errors - Let me know if you find any bugs. I am hoping we will be ready for full release soon.

- Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Content Search Improved
notes.content: We fixed a number of issues related to the content search. Also we updated the reset button to reset the theme. We now recommended Office 2019 Dark as a good dark theme. Let me know if you have any issues.

notes.title: Added sound for spelling in games
notes.content: Added sound button for spelling in maze game. We are still testing and improving, but we wanted to push out a small test.

notes.title: Fixed content search
notes.content: Fixed content search when installed on drives other than C:

notes.title: Workshop Content Easier to Search
notes.content: We have made it easy to search for study content. A single click for open or subscribe. Fixed right to left for languages. Fixed the skip button to be marked as wrong. We are still working on some of the interface languages.

notes.title: Fixed Distractors (extra wrong answers)
notes.content:
Distractors are working much better now. Also, StudyX is complete. Can't wait for full release :)

Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Improved number support and true/false
notes.content:
Improved number support and true/false support. Enjoy!

Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Study With Images
notes.content:
You can easily add images to StudyX questions and answers. To enlarge, just click the image.  Also, we are still adding more to the workshop. Enjoy!

-Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Early Access and Beta
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are finishing StudyX testing in beta and about to launch in Early Access next month! We will be uploading content files next week to the workshop to make sure that we start with some tons of great content. Comment or post in the forum with any suggestions you have. 

Thanks!
Jeff
